description: Update the existing promotional combined-shipping rule: thresholds, item count, shipping cost, and/or combinedDuration (Account API v2 updatePromotionalShippingRule). marketplaceId is sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header. Returns success (eBay 204 No Content); confirm with ebay_get_combined_shipping_rules. Requires sell.account.

marketplaceId.description: eBay marketplace sent as the required X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID header, e.g. EBAY_US

combinedDuration.description: Window in which unpaid orders can be combined into one invoice (CombinedPaymentPeriodEnum): DAYS_3, DAYS_5, DAYS_7, DAYS_14, DAYS_30, or INELIGIBLE

promotionalShippingRule.description: Promotional rule: discount or free shipping above an amount or item count

combinedShippingRuleType.description: CombinedShippingRuleTypeEnum: COMBINED_ITEM_WEIGHT, EACH_ADDITIONAL_AMOUNT, EACH_ADDITIONAL_AMOUNT_OFF, EACH_ADDITIONAL_PERCENT_OFF, INDIVIDUAL_ITEM_WEIGHT, MAXIMUM_SHIPPING_COST_PER_ORDER, SHIPPING_COST_X_FOR_AMOUNT_Y, SHIPPING_COST_X_FOR_ITEM_COUNT_N, or WEIGHT_OFF

itemCount.description: Number of items a buyer must purchase to qualify for the promotion

orderAmount.description: Minimum order amount required to qualify for the promotion

value.description: Monetary amount as a decimal string, e.g. "2.50"

shippingCost.description: Total (discounted) shipping cost for the qualifying combined order

name: ebay_update_promotional_shipping_rule
